fields.subject: The notice's subject, e.g. "Afiax invoice ACC-SINV-2026-00012 is overdue".
fields.headline: The heading in the email.
fields.message: What happened, in one or two sentences, with the amount and date in words.
fields.tenantId: The organisation ID, to quote when there is no invoice.
fields.invoiceNumber: Optional. The invoice the notice is about.
fields.amount: Optional. Amount due in KES, formatted, e.g. 6,960.
fields.showPay: true when there is something to pay.
fields.mpesaAccount: The account number for the paybill: the invoice number, or the organisation ID.
fields.billingUrl: The portal's Bills and payments page.
fields.next: Optional. What happens next, with the date, stated as a fact.
